hero.title: The Right Doctor Matters. The Right Hospital Matters Too.
hero.subtitle: Helping international patients connect with suitable hospitals and specialist doctors in India.
hero.description: India has thousands of hospitals and a large number of medical specialists. Choosing the right healthcare provider can be challenging when you are in another country. IBN Sina helps patients explore appropriate healthcare options based on their medical needs.

introduction.title: Personalized Hospital & Doctor Coordination
introduction.description: Every patient's medical condition is unique. Instead of providing a generic list of hospitals, we carefully understand your medical requirements and help coordinate with appropriate hospitals and specialists in India.

items.title: Specialist Doctors
items.description: Connect with experienced medical specialists based on your diagnosis and treatment requirements.

items.title: Multispecialty Hospitals
items.description: Access leading hospitals offering comprehensive care across multiple medical specialties.

items.title: Specialized Treatment Centres
items.description: Receive guidance toward hospitals and centres dedicated to your specific medical condition.

items.title: Advanced Diagnostic Facilities
items.description: Coordinate diagnostic investigations with modern medical facilities.

items.title: Surgical Care
items.description: Support in connecting with experienced surgical teams for appropriate treatment.

items.title: International Patient Services
items.description: Benefit from dedicated hospital departments that assist international patients throughout their treatment journey.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.description: We believe the right healthcare decision should begin with understanding the patient's medical condition—not by recommending the same hospital to everyone.

cta.title: Find the Right Hospital for Your Treatment
cta.description: Our patient coordinators are here to help you explore suitable hospitals and specialist doctors based on your individual healthcare needs.
